title: Leveraging Prototypical Representations for Mitigating Social Bias without Demographic Information

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the True Positive Rate Gap (TPR-GAP) and statistical fairness metrics (Independence, Separation, and Sufficiency) on an occupation prediction task using the Bias in Bios dataset, which contains male and female biographies.

Evaluating the True Positive Rate Gap (TPR-GAP) and statistical fairness metrics (Independence, Separation, and Sufficiency) on a Twitter sentiment analysis task, using sociolects (African American English vs. Standard American English) as a proxy for racial identity.
